hotfixes.hardstop_boundary: CLI catches HardStop -> atomic failure_report.json + diagnostics.json, exit code 1; outcomes distinguished: completed/interrupted/failed
hotfixes.artifacts: result.json carries selected_epoch, optimizer_steps, thresholds, threshold_grid, outcome, val_history; resolved_manifest.json carries resolved_args, grid, aggregation, data/fold SHAs, profile/seed/fold
hotfixes.threshold_grid: pinned THRESHOLD_GRID passed explicitly to per_class_thresholds everywhere
